context_for_next_testing_agent: Signature and Drawing system fully tested. Key features verified: 1) Company Settings signature toggle saves and controls visibility, 2) Order Detail notes tab shows 3 signature sections when enabled (Order Authorization, Change Approval, Pickup Confirmation), 3) Signature request dialog sends public sign link, 4) Internal capture signature modal works with drawing canvas, pen size, undo, clear, 5) Drawing modal supports all tools (color picker, pen size, undo, clear, type selector, label, notes), 6) Drawings tab shows combined order/item/image drawings with filter buttons, 7) Job Ticket Detail has drawings tab with Enable toggle and Add Sketch/Notes button, 8) Feature hidden behavior verified - signature UI disappears when toggle is OFF. Skipped tests: Item-level drawings and image markup tests skipped because test order has no job tickets or uploaded images.
